title: Iterator Pattern
description: Write a Zig program that implements a custom iterator for a Fibonacci sequence using the Zig iterator protocol.
verificationTest: output.includes('0') && output.includes('1') && output.includes('2') && output.includes('3') && output.includes('5') && output.includes('8') && output.includes('13') && output.includes('21') && output.includes('34')
hints: Zig's iterator protocol uses a method named `next` that returns an optional value
Return `null` from `next()` to signal iteration is complete
The iterator state (a, b) is mutated as `next()` is called
